name: holvi-agent-bridge-extension
description: Chrome extension tooling for Holvi Agent Bridge.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist/extension target/extension-tsgo && tsgo -p tsconfig.extension.json --outDir target/extension-tsgo && mkdir -p dist/extension && cp target/extension-tsgo/extension/config.js target/extension-tsgo/extension/content.js dist/extension/ && bun build src/extension/background.ts --target browser --format iife --banner '"use strict";' --outfile dist/extension/background.js && cp src/extension/manifest.json dist/extension/manifest.json
scripts.check:format: oxfmt --check src/extension package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.extension.json tsconfig.extension-test.json .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src/extension package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.extension.json tsconfig.extension-test.json .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json
scripts.sync:artifacts: bun run build && rm -rf assets/extension && mkdir -p assets/extension && cp dist/extension/* assets/extension/
